column2: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 阶段复盘(第3轮)
Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。
because answers why, strongest tone|since = since, based on a known fact|as = as, weakest tone|now that = since|when because is used, so is not used in the main clause
Since everyone is here, let's begin the class.
column3: 既然大家都到了,我们开始上课吧。

column1: _____ everyone is here, let's begin the class.
column4: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 Since。句意:既然大家都到了,我们开始上课吧。

column2: He didn't go to school because he was ill.
He didn't go to school so he was ill.|He didn't go to school because he was ill.|He didn't go to school because of he was ill.|He didn't go to school as for he was ill.
column4: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:He didn't go to school because he was ill.

column2: As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
column3: 由于天晚了,我们最好打车。

column1: 「由于天晚了,我们最好打车。」的正确英文是?
column2: As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.|Since that it is late, we'd better take a taxi.|For it is late, we'd better take a taxi.|Because of it is late, we'd better take a taxi.
column4: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:As it is late, we'd better take a taxi.

column2: Now that the work is done, you can rest.
column3: 既然工作做完了,你可以休息了。

column1: _____ the work is done, you can rest.
column4: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 Now that。句意:既然工作做完了,你可以休息了。

column2: I stayed because the meeting was long.
column3: 因为会议很长,我留下来了。

column2: I stayed because the meeting was long.|I stayed due the meeting was long.|I stayed because of the meeting was long.|I stayed so the meeting was long.
column4: because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。正确句:I stayed because the meeting was long.

column2: Since you know the answer, please tell us.
